objective: Turn the A05 structural data-quality rollups already emitted in staging into explicit ownership and fail-closed maturity-promotion evidence without creating a second data authority.

rootCause.currentRuntime: ANA-A05 emits projection-missing and reconciliation-mismatch rollups, but their health_state values do not define canonical owner, minimum evidence floor or maturity-promotion semantics.
rootCause.governanceGap: ANA-001 cannot claim maturity 4 while a nonzero structural reconciliation defect, missing required rollup or no-data window can be interpreted ad hoc.
rootCause.boundary: This sublot governs promotion evidence only. It is not a business KPI anomaly system, production SLO, alert-delivery authority or source-domain mutation mechanism.

policies.rationale: A known missing canonical ORD projection is a structural integrity defect, so any observed nonzero rate blocks ANA maturity promotion.
A known ORD-to-ANA event or immutable-dimension mismatch is a structural integrity defect, so any observed nonzero rate blocks ANA maturity promotion.

pendingMetricsPolicy: Not part of the A06 pass decision until a canonical runtime emitter, unit, sample floor and threshold policy exist. Absence must not be represented as zero.
preservedBoundaries: Product Analytics remains distinct from operational observability.
ORD remains canonical for order facts; ANA owns only analytics projection integrity.
Browser analytics remains disabled by default.
LEGAL-B03 remains the authority for consent, retention, anonymization and holder rights.
PAY-001 remains the authority for payment facts and financial metrics.

maturity.reason: A06 repository governance is implemented and authorized staging read-only evidence is recorded, but the latest staging observation is hold because both required rollups are no_data with sample_count=0. ANA remains 3/6 and still requires a separately authorized non-empty reconciliation canary plus the funnel, CAT supply/liquidity, retention and freshness sublots.
